title: PageRank: where a random surfer spends its time
sub: A five-page web. The fraction of time a random surfer spends on each page is its PageRank, and power iteration computes it directly.

frames.caption: A random surfer starts on A. Each step: with probability 0.85 click a random link on the page, otherwise jump to a random page anywhere.
Step 1: followed a link to B. Labels show the share of time spent on each page so far.
Step 2: followed a link to C. Labels show the share of time spent on each page so far.

After 5,000 steps, the time-shares are the PageRank: A 36%, B 19%, C 36%, D 5%, E 4%. Compare them with power iteration.
Power iteration: start with every page at 1/5 = 20%. Each round, every page passes 85% of its score evenly along its links, and everyone gets an equal 3% share of the rest.
